info.title: German Real Estate Foreclosure & ZVG-Portal Scraper
info.description:
Monitors all official German judicial foreclosure auctions from zvg-portal.de across all 16 federal states with market appraisals, court file numbers, land registry details and auction dates.

Synchronous API endpoint returning structured dataset items directly.
